g.text: Waiting-state allocation and process RSS are different costs
Linux ARM64; medians of 3 independent diagnostic processes. Allocator counters exclude metadata and JIT mmap.
Monty-clear rebinds quotes = []; one loop row remains. VM capacity survives logical release. No trim calls or confidence intervals.
